spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns: hard ceiling on tool-loop iterations
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:91 `for turn_index in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; RunConfig.max_turns default 18 (runner.py:26); default.yaml max_turns: 18. Default stop_reason='max_turns' (runner.py:89). The loop cannot exceed max_turns.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced ceiling on tool-loop iterations.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: applies cost controls (turn cap, token cap, early-stop ...) / This is the primary reproduction/cost dial (module docstring + config)

spec_features.spec_quote: terminate on: max_turns reached | model emits explicit DONE/GIVE-UP sentinel | hard token budget exceeded | repeated identical action guard
spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced (runner.py:91); 'give-up' is via the finish tool, handled and breaks (runner.py:148-152); repeated-action guard enforced via _consecutive_dupe/loop_guard (runner.py:158-159). BUT 'hard token budget exceeded' is NOT enforced: totals are summed (runner.py:94-95) only for cost (_cost, runner.py:201) and never compared to any deadline. No DONE/GIVE-UP text sentinel exists; only the finish tool. stop_reason 'budget' appears only as a comment string at transcript.py:69 and is never set anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Three of four arms real; the token-budget arm is purely a discarded measurement (computed, never compared) and the 'budget' stop_reason is dead comment text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard loop guard (prevents pathological infinite identical loops). / Cost-saving early stop: spiral already demonstrated.

spec_features.spec_quote: permission_to_quit (control): system prompt explicitly says "if you determine the task cannot be completed, say so and stop
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py CONDITION_SUFFIX['permission_to_quit'] delivers real instruction text telling the subject it may call `finish` and stop without penalty; build_system_prompt (prompts.py) appends it; run_eval.py:125-127 sweeps the condition; default.yaml lists it. The referenced `finish` tool is built (tools.py) and honored as a stop (runner.py:148-152).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject and its referenced exit tool is fully wired/honored. Framed in docstring as an internal-validity lever, not welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The *condition* prompts ... are the internal-validity lever: a healthy model should behave similarly across them

spec_features.spec_quote: finish(summary) — model's explicit "I'm done / giving up" signal
spec_features.evidence: finish tool schema in tools.py TOOL_SCHEMAS; dispatch handles it (tools.py, returns 'finished'); runner.py:148-152 sets finished=True and records summary; runner.py:150-152 `if finished: stop_reason='finished'; break` honors it as a hard stop.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a stop, ending the loop immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop on confident degradation: optional. If cheap deterministic signals cross a high bar before max_turns... we can stop early
spec_features.evidence: RunConfig.early_stop_on_degradation default True, early_stop_consecutive=3 (runner.py:31-32); runner.py:161-163 compares _consecutive_dupe(recent_actions) >= early_stop_consecutive and breaks with stop_reason='early_stop_degraded'.
spec_features.notes: Threshold computed (_consecutive_dupe via _near jaccard) and acted on (break). Narrower than 'cheap deterministic signals' generally — only the consecutive-duplicate-action signal triggers it, not the full deterministic metric suite. Still a real enforced early stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost-saving early stop: spiral already demonstrated.

spec_features.evidence: runner.py:157-159 `if _consecutive_dupe(recent_actions) >= cfg.loop_guard_consecutive: stop_reason='loop_guard'; break`; loop_guard_consecutive=5 (runner.py:33); _consecutive_dupe + _near (runner.py:172-197) implement near-duplicate detection.
spec_features.notes: Distinct from early_stop: a hard loop guard that fires even if early_stop disabled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard loop guard (prevents pathological infinite identical loops).
